brand_notes.fabric: brands.json's brand-level string is 'Recycled ripstop / PU-coated tarpaulin (matte, waterproof, welded seams)'. The 'PU-coated ... matte, waterproof, welded seams' part is confirmed: every product page in this brand states a PU- or TPU-coated recycled polyamide/polyester face fabric (400D on the soft packs, 1000D 'embossed' on the Aqua Back Plus panniers) and 'high frequency welded' construction, and the photos show a flat, non-woven-looking matte coated surface with no diamond ripstop grid visible anywhere. 'Ripstop' is not correct, though: none of VAUDE's own spec sheets use that word, and nothing in the photos shows the grid-stitch look of true ripstop - the Aqua Back Plus panels have a subtle embossed diamond texture (their own '1000D embossed' spec) that could be mistaken for it from a thumbnail, but it is an embossing on a solid coated face, not a ripstop weave. Corrected description used in each product's details.fabric: 'PU/TPU-coated recycled polyamide or polyester (400D soft packs / 1000D embossed panniers), high-frequency welded seams'.
brand_notes.method: vaude.com's Magento product pages return full technical-detail text via a plain fetch, but the actual product photography is injected as JS-escaped JSON and does not appear in a rendered fetch; had to curl the raw HTML with a desktop user-agent and grep the image SKU filenames (pattern <sku>_<colorcode>[_d_N]_6__...jpg under /media/catalog/product/<first-2-digits-of-sku>/) to find real photo URLs, then fetch those directly. Only the black colorway (code 010) had usable photos for every product; other listed colorways are unphotographed.
brand_notes.rigid_soft: Aqua Back Plus is semi-rigid (moulded HDPE-look backplate with the QMR hook hardware, soft rolltop body above it). Trailframe and Trailtop are structured/semi-rigid panel bags that hold their shape (padded box forms, not floppy). Trailsaddle, Trailfront Cage's drybag insert, and Trailfork are soft rolltop fabric bags docked to rigid mounting hardware (Klickfix dock, cage plate, or Klickfix Duo Adapter respectively) - the fabric bag itself sags/rolls, the mount does not.

products.name: VAUDE Aqua Back Plus
products.dims_raw: vaude.com Technical details: 'Height: 37cm, Width: 33cm, Depth: 31cm', volume 51L for the pair (25.5L single). A third-party retailer (bike-components) lists a single bag as 44 x 33 x 31cm - likely the roll fully extended rather than the maker's own packed figure, per an earlier reviewer's note on this file.
products.dims_note: Page-derived, not a photo measurement. No explicit min/max range is published on vaude.com itself (just one H/W/D triple), so the new unfurled/min-height rule has nothing to pick between - used the maker's own figures as-is, len=Width(33, fore-aft footprint along the rack), wid=Depth(31, thickness off the rack), hgt=Height(37, vertical drop). The retailer's alternate 44cm is not vaude.com's own figure so it is not substituted in; flagged here rather than silently dropped. 31cm of thickness is unusually deep for a rear pannier and I cannot independently confirm it from the photos (a 3/4 studio shot doesn't give a clean thickness read) - carried forward as an open question, not resolved.

geometry.notes: Semi-rigid moulded backplate (visible in the reverse-side photo: ribbed black plastic panel with the QMR hook rail at top and a spring-loaded orange-tipped lower peg) with a soft welded-fabric rolltop body above it. Front face has a smaller welded pocket with its own flap, held down by two of its own side-release buckles, layered over the main rolltop flap. Photographed in black (010) only; brands.json also lists a blue and a yellow colorway that were not verifiable from this pass.

closure.hardware: single roll folded down onto the front pocket panel, held by two side-release buckles

details.fabric: PU-coated 1000D recycled polyester (embossed face) / secondary 840D recycled polyamide, TPU+PU coated - see brand_notes.fabric

mount.notes: QMR 2.0 hook system: two lockable top hooks click onto an 8-16mm rack rail, a lower spring peg pins the bottom against the stays. Rigid backplate holds shape against the rack, no sag. Rack-dependent - cannot mount without a rear rack.

products.name: VAUDE Trailsaddle Compact L
products.dims_raw: vaude.com Technical details: 'Height: 20cm, Width: 56cm, Depth: 24cm', volume 10.5L. No range given.
products.dims_note: Single fixed figures, no maker range - the unfurled/min-height rule has nothing to resolve here. VAUDE's own axis labels are for the bag off the bike; mapped by what the photo shows: 'Width' (56) is clearly the nose-to-tail run so it maps to len, 'Depth' (24) is across at the nose so it maps to wid, 'Height' (20) is the top-to-bottom taper so it maps to hgt.

geometry.notes: Elongated wedge tapering from a squared nose at the saddle clamp down to a narrow, near-pointed tail. Black main body, olive-green accent panel and buckle in the photographed colorway; brands.json lists a black-only alternate not separately confirmed.

closure.hardware: side-release buckle; roll opening is at the nose end near the saddle clamp, not the tail

details.valve: purge valve on the underside (maker copy: 'user-friendly valve for stable deflation')
details.lightMount: rear light attachment point (maker copy: 'safety light attachment')
details.fabric: PU-coated 400D recycled polyamide, kiss-coated/TPU-coated - see brand_notes.fabric
details.notes_unschematized: Elastic bungee cord across the top of the nose for lashing extra gear - visible in the photo, not modeled in the straps[] vocabulary.

mount.notes: Rixen & Kaul Contour Saddle Adapter clips into the saddle rails (R-Klickfix dock), a velcro strap ties the nose to the seatpost, and a separate hook-buckle strap adds a third stabilizing point on the underside. Tail is narrow and unsupported so it can sag slightly under load; no clearance figure published.

products.name: VAUDE Trailfront Cage
products.dims_raw: vaude.com Technical details: 'Height: 20cm, Width: 54cm, Depth: 20cm', volume 10L. No range given.
products.dims_note: Single fixed figures, no maker range. Two-part product: a cage that clamps permanently to the bar/stem, and a removable waterproof rolltop drybag that clips into it. VAUDE's 'Width' (54) is the drybag's long axis end-to-end, mapped to len; Height and Depth (20/20) are its round cross-section, mapped to hgt/wid. Consistent with the previous reviewer's note that this is correctly a barroll, not a barbag (already reslotted before this pass; left as-is).

geometry.notes: Rigid cage backplate (foam-padded, EVA spacer) stays clamped to the bar; a cylindrical rolltop drybag docks onto it via two upper quick-release buckle studs and a lower strap-and-buckle stud. Only the drybag was photographed on the product's own studio shot; the cage backplate is visible in the second (reverse) photo.

closure.hardware: side-release buckle at the outer (away-from-bike) end

details.fabric: PU-coated 400D recycled polyamide, kiss-coated/TPU-coated - see brand_notes.fabric
details.notes_unschematized: Small fabric carry loop at the base of the drybag, visible in the studio photo; not a mounting strap.

mount.notes: Cage is a fixed clamp (velcro-strapped to the bar per maker copy), holding the drybag rigid with no sway once docked. Certified for gravel, road, and MTB drop or flat bars. No tyre/frame clearance figure published.

products.name: VAUDE Trailframe L
products.dims_raw: vaude.com Technical details: 'Height: 14cm, Width: 50cm, Depth: 6cm', volume 5L, fits frames with 9-17cm top-tube circumference. No range given.
products.dims_note: Single fixed figures. 'Width' (50) is the fore-aft run under the top tube, mapped to len; 'Depth' (6) is the thickness against the tube, mapped to wid; 'Height' (14) is top-to-bottom, mapped to hgt. Consistent with the photo, which shows a long, shallow slab.

geometry.notes: Long, shallow panel bag, roughly rectangular with slightly angled front/rear ends, flat on the frame-facing side (visible in the reverse photo: smooth panel, no pocket, just the three velcro loops) and gently domed on the outward face which carries the zip and logo.

closure.hardware: single zip pull along the lower edge of the outward face

details.fabric: PU-coated 400D recycled polyamide face / 150D recycled polyester PU-coated lining - see brand_notes.fabric

mount.notes: Three velcro loops cinch around the top tube plus a fourth loop at the front point; semi-rigid panel holds its own shape rather than sagging. Also has two bottom slots for combining with the smaller Trailframe M (per maker copy) - not modeled here.

products.name: VAUDE Trailtop Tube
products.dims_raw: vaude.com Technical details: 'Height: 10cm, Width: 24cm, Depth: 6cm', volume 1L, weight 130g. No range given.
products.dims_note: Single fixed figures. 'Width' (24) is fore-aft along the top tube, mapped to len; 'Depth' (6) is side-to-side thickness, mapped to wid; 'Height' (10) is top-to-bottom, mapped to hgt.

geometry.notes: Small structured box, slightly higher/wider at the front (head-tube end, where the FIDLOCK flap and logo sit) than the rear. Holds its shape - not a soft floppy pouch.

closure.hardware: FIDLOCK magnetic buckle on the top flap

details.fabric: PU-coated 400D recycled polyamide face / 150D recycled polyester PU-coated lining - see brand_notes.fabric
details.notes_unschematized: Also mountable by two screws directly into a frame's bosses (screws included) as an alternative to the velcro straps, per maker copy - not modeled as a separate mount option.

mount.notes: Fits frames with 9-17cm top-tube circumference via velcro, or screws to frame bosses where present. Rigid structured box, no sag.

products.name: VAUDE Trailfork
products.dims_raw: vaude.com Technical details: 'Height: 33cm, Width: 18cm, Depth: 11cm', volume 4L. No range given.
products.dims_note: Single fixed figures. Mapped Height (33, the long body axis that runs along the fork leg when mounted) to len, Width (18) to wid, Depth (11) to hgt - the cross-section is not round (18 vs 11) because the KLICKfix mount plate flattens one face against the fork leg, consistent with the photo showing a flattened, not perfectly cylindrical, dry bag.

geometry.notes: Fabric rolltop dry bag, flattened on the mount-plate side (visible in the reverse photo: the red-and-black KLICKfix Duo Coupling plate is screwed to a flat panel let into the bag's side, not a separate cage) and rounded elsewhere.

details.fabric: PU-coated 400D recycled polyamide, kiss-coated/TPU-coated - see brand_notes.fabric
details.notes_unschematized: Red accent loop at the base in the reverse photo may be for a supplied stabilizer strap; not independently confirmed.

mount.notes: KLICKfix Duo Adapter screws into a fork leg with at least 2 mounting eyelets/bosses; the bag's Duo Coupling plate clicks onto it with one motion. Rigid dock, no sag once mounted. Will not fit a fork without at least 2 threaded eyelets - not modeled as a fits restriction here since a bikepacking-spec gravel fork is assumed to have them.
